output.reason: New bladder control trouble and numbness between the legs one week after a lifting back injury are cardinal features of possible cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency assessment with MRI.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression at the base of the spine, which needs urgent imaging and specialist assessment today to prevent permanent damage. Do not wait for a message reply. If you develop leg weakness, cannot walk, or cannot urinate at all, call 911.
